status: Environment and dataset preparation in progress

phases.title: Source & protocol
phases.detail: Pinned upstream source, nested dependencies and all 12 dataset assets. Official training arguments captured directly.

phases.title: H800 environments
phases.detail: Isolated policy and world-model environments. CPU setup only; actual CUDA extensions and simulator checks pending.

phases.title: Release data
phases.detail: Resumable pinned download is active; first checkpoint archive has received over 80 MiB. Full 485.3 GiB asset set and SHA-256 acceptance are still pending.

phases.title: GPU acceptance
phases.detail: Both environment kernel checks, simulator step, policy/WM service smoke and three 200-update training smoke runs.

phases.title: Self collection
phases.detail: Two scripted-expert successes per task, up to 20 attempts each. Keep failed attempts. Not human teleoperation.

phases.title: Full training
phases.detail: Shared Stage 1, PhysMani Stage 2 and 3DFA fine-tuning: 100,000 updates each, seed 0, 3 idle GPUs, batch 18 per GPU.

phases.title: Policy evaluation
phases.detail: Released and retrained PhysMani/3DFA; five checkpoints, 16 tasks, 40 episodes each: 12,800 episodes.

phases.title: World-model quality
phases.detail: 640 held-out trajectories; horizons 1/5/10 at 0.05 s per frame. PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and depth log RMSE. Object-center error requires verified GT.

blockers: Latest resource check: all development GPUs had existing compute processes. No GPU jobs launched.
